question: What's the right SDR daily activity volume in 2026 — calls, emails, LinkedIn touches?
answer:
# SDR Daily Activity Targets for 2026 ## The Quick Answer SDRs should aim for **8-12 calls, 20-30 emails, and 15-25 LinkedIn touches per day**, with conversion focus trumping raw volume. Quality sequences on **Apollo** or **Outreach** beat spray-and-pray prospecting. ## Why Volume Matters (But Not How You Think) Outbound prospecting lives in tension: **more touches = more replies**, but exhausted reps tank quality. Modern SDR performance splits into three lanes: - **Call volume**: **8-12 outbound calls** daily (not all connect; expect **15-20% live connects**). Pavilion data shows reps hitting **4-6 real conversations** per day is the ceiling before fatigue kills pitch quality. - **Email sequences**: **20-30 personalized touches** weekly (not daily blasts). **Bridge Group** research: SDRs on **Outreach/Salesloft** multi-step sequences see **25-35% reply rates** when segmented tight; single-touch spray nets **5-8%**. - **LinkedIn outreach**: **15-25 touches/week** (not daily). **OpenView** data: LinkedIn sequences converting at **8-12%** when paired with phone follow-up within **48 hours**. ## The Operating Model Build SDR rhythms around *blocks*, not random taps: | Activity | Daily Target | Tool | Outcome | |----------|--------------|------|----------| | Prospecting calls | 8–12 | **Apollo** intelligence pre-dial | 4–6 live connects | | Sequence emails | 20–30/week | **Outreach/Salesloft** | 25–35% reply if segmented | | LinkedIn + 1st msg | 3–5 daily | **Apollo** sync or native | 8–12% interested | | Call recordings | 2–3 daily | **Gong** + peer coaching | Rep skill compound | ## Conversion Math That Matters Stop counting touches; count *conversations*: - **12 calls/day × 20% connect = 2.4 conversations** → ~**6-8 qualified conversations/week** → ~**1 qualified opportunity/week** - **25-email sequence × 30% reply = 7.5 replies** → ~**3-4 real conversations** → **1 qualified opportunity** - **LinkedIn daily touch + phone follow-up = 2.5x reply rate lift** (OpenView) ## The Traps **Reps gaming numbers**: 100 "touches" that are template-blasted LinkedIn spam don't convert. **Salesloft/Outreach** users who segment, personalize, and rotate sequences see **3-4x reply uplift**. **No call prep**: Dialing blind kills connect rates. Use **Apollo** or **Bridge Group** insights to pre-research pain, then dial with context. **Ignoring reply velocity**: **Gong** shows: reps who call **within 2 hours of email open** move deals **30% faster**. Batch email sends for early AM, call warm leads by 10 AM. ## 2026 Shift: Speed + Specialization **Pavilion's latest playbook** combines: 1. **Niche SDR pods** (3-4 reps per vertical) → higher contact quality, tighter messaging 2. **Apollo + Outreach integration** → pre-dial intel + auto-logged calls + fast follow-up 3. **1-1 coaching loops** (Gong recordings) → skill lift matters more than dial count Target reps at **$60-90K salary** closing **8-15 opportunities/month** (not touches) to earn **$150K+ OTE** on **20-30% commission**. ```mermaid flowchart TD A["Daily SDR Start"] --> B["Segment Target List
